controles.affirmation: Hook : "le seul goodwill du groupe (3,4 Mds $) depasse ses capitaux propres totaux (4,0 Mds $)".
controles.correction_proposee: Erreur arithmetique : 3 382,6 M$ est INFERIEUR a 4 008,0 M$. Seul le cumul goodwill + incorporels nets (4 547,1 M$) depasse les capitaux propres, comme l'ecrit d'ailleurs correctement le corps de l'ATT. Reformuler le hook : "le goodwill et les incorporels du groupe (4,5 Mds $) depassent ses capitaux propres totaux (4,0 Mds $)".

controles.affirmation: Goodwill 3 382,6 M$ + incorporels nets 1 164,5 M$ = 4 547,1 M$, superieur aux capitaux propres (4 008,0 M$) et egal a 66% du total de bilan (6 930,0 M$) ; pas de depreciation depuis le test du 31 octobre 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Goodwill 3,382.6 | Intangible assets - net 1,164.5 | Total assets $6,930.0" ; "Total shareholders' equity 4,008.0" ; "There have been no events or circumstances since the last annual goodwill and indefinite-lived intangible asset impairment assessment date, October 31, 2025, that would have required an interim impairment test."

controles.affirmation: FSDP recule de 1% en organique au T2 2026 quand HST progresse de 12% ; marge d'EBITDA ajuste FSDP a 28,9% (-50 bps).
IDEX et huit de ses filiales sont defendeurs dans des poursuites amiante ; la grande majorite des reclamations ont ete rejetees sans paiement ; un seul dossier juge, verdict favorable.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Part II Item 1 Legal Proceedings : "the Company and eight of its subsidiaries are presently named as defendants in a number of lawsuits claiming various asbestos-related personal injuries... Most of the claims resolved to date have been dismissed without payment. The balance of the claims has been settled for various immaterial amounts. Only one case has been tried, resulting in a verdict for the Company's business unit."
controles.correction_proposee: Deux imprecisions mineures : (1) le passage se trouve en Part II, Item 1 "Legal Proceedings", pas dans la note 14 comme l'indique l'ATT ; (2) le filing dit "Most of the claims" (la plupart), l'ATT ecrit "la grande majorite", legere amplification.

controles.affirmation: La Cour supreme a invalide le 20 fevrier 2026 les tarifs IEEPA ; le remboursement a apporte 0,08 $ par action et 150 points de base a la marge brute au T2 2026 ; l'administration a mis en place de nouveaux tarifs sous une autre autorite legale.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court issued a decision invalidating the broad-based tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act" ; "The net impact of IEEPA tariff refunds... contributed an $0.08 benefit to EPS" ; "Positive price/cost was driven by the net benefit of IEEPA tariff refunds of $7.3 million, which benefited Gross margin for the three... months ended June 30, 2026 by 150 basis points" ; "In response to the U.S. Supreme Court ruling, the administration implemented new tariffs under alternative statutory authority"

controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, MD&A Covenants : "a minimum interest coverage ratio of 3.0 to 1 and a maximum leverage ratio of 3.50 to 1. At June 30, 2026, the Company's interest coverage ratio was 14.17 to 1... and the leverage ratio was 1.87 to 1." ; ratings BBB / Baa2 / BBB+
